messages:
Maria: Quick sync — we need to finalize KPI mapping for the Console observability work. Customers (LargeRetailCo + FinApps) require cost-per-request by route, p95 latency, and groupable error trends. Can product/eng align on what MVP looks like?

Ashwin: +1. My concern: per-route cost needs token attribution + sampling. Full per-token billing is heavy. Proposal: 1) sample cost per-request at 1% for all routes, 2) full attribution for top 100 routes by traffic.

Kevin: Sampling approach seems fine. Need to ensure trace hooks capture route id early (before batching) — otherwise attribution is wrong. Also we should define canary gating: no increase in tail latency >5% on canary nodes.

Sophie: From PM side: customers want dashboard widgets: top cost routes, error spike heatmap, traces for error windows. Can we scope an initial dashboard with 3 widgets and a drilldown to traces (linked)?

Ashwin: 3 widgets OK. Implementation plan: tracing hook to emit `route_id` + `cost_estimate` tags. Example:
```
span.set_tag("route_id", route)
span.set_tag("cost_estimate", estimated_microtokens)
```
We can schlep cost_estimate from batching service; needs a lightweight RPC.

Maria: Nice. Launch criteria suggestion:
- Dash: 3 widgets + drilldown
- Traces: route_id tag present for 95% of sampled traces
- Cost: sample-based per-route cost with top-100 exacts
- Error analytics: grouping + at least 2 auto-detected regressions within 24h
- Canary: 10% traffic, p95 latency delta <= +5%, errors delta <= +10%

Kevin: Add SLOs for trace tagging failure rate (alert if >10% missing). Also log retention for cost attribution — need 14d for initial evaluation.

Sophie: Customer asks prioritized: 1) per-route cost, 2) error groups + alerting, 3) trace drilldown. If we have to cut scope, drop full top-100 exacts and keep sampled + quick sort for top 20.

Ashwin: Implementation risks: KV cache overhead for tagging, additional traffic for cost RPC, and DB write load for aggregated cost. Mitigations: async batch writes, incremental rollout, and rate-limited sampling.

Maria: Timeline idea -> week 1: tracing hook + sampling; week 2: dashboard widgets + drilldown; week 3: canary + metrics/alerts. Engineering owners?

Ashwin: Owner (tracing + cost tags): Ashwin
Kevin: Owner (canary + SLOs/alerts): Kevin
Sophie: Owner (dashboard UX + customer sign-off): Sophie

ops-bot: deploy-canary scheduled for 2024-05-10 03:00 UTC (v2.14-canary)

Maria: OK I'll capture this in PRD and attach the proposed canary gate thresholds. @Sophie please capture customer consent checklist. :thumbsup:

Sophie: Will do. Adding checklist to PRD: customer contact, rollback plan, runbook.

Kevin: Also adding a small smoke test: synthetic requests to top-10 routes and check p95.

Ashwin: One more ask — can we include a tiny CSV export for cost per-route for customers? Low-effort and high-value.

Maria: Good idea. Add to backlog as optional MVP+.

Sophie: timeline looks tight but doable if we limit exact-cost scope. :eyes:

Maria: Thanks all — next check-in Friday 11am PT. I'll post PRD link when ready.
